title: Verify Word Info Modal
description: Verify the word-by-word info modal works correctly.

acceptanceCriteria.text: BROWSER TEST: Click lyric line → modal opens
BROWSER TEST: Modal shows word-by-word breakdown
BROWSER TEST: Each word shows: Persian, transliteration, Hebrew, English
BROWSER TEST: Click word audio button → shows "Audio not available (coming soon)" (US-031 pending)
